summary: Mobile MD app (MobileMdApp) tested at 390x844 via public preview URL. Login as md@kainnusantara.id → mobile-md-app renders (NOT mobile-ops-app). All 5 tabs (Meja/Desain/Sample/Produk/Lainnya) present and switch correctly. Meja shows metric-open (15), metric-oldest (2 hari), all 4 queues (desain/sample/pr/acuan) with toggles and rows. Design tab list + m-dsr-new present. Sample tab m-rnd-samples + m-smp-search present. Produk tab m-md-products (20 cards) + search + category chips; product detail shows m-md-product-price, m-md-product-stock, m-md-product-edit. Lainnya shows m-md-more with push/pwa cards, m-md-entity-switch (Semua/Sukacita/Kanda), all 5 sub menus (pr/po/pricelist/price-status/stock) and all 15 full-view menus. Sub PR opens m-md-sub-pr with m-pr-new and back button works. Full-view (rnd-specs) opens desktop page with mobile-back-to-app returning correctly to mobile-md-app. Notif bell opens mobile-notif-sheet. No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Regression for sales/salesadmin not re-tested this iteration (previous iterations 81/82 covered — behaviour unchanged, they should still route to their own apps).

integration_issues.flow: Meja → tap desain row → open Desain detail
integration_issues.issue: In one test run the click on m-md-row-desain-<id> did not switch tab to Desain (stayed on Meja and m-dsr-detail missing). Likely caused by notif sheet remaining open from a prior open (Escape did not close overlay) rather than a real product bug — mdRowTarget/go logic in MobileMdApp is correct. Re-test with fresh state to confirm.

action_items: Re-verify Meja row navigation for all 4 queues (desain→m-dsr-detail, sample→m-smp-detail, pr→m-md-sub-pr, acuan→full-view with mobile-back-to-app) — main agent can self-test since tap handlers look correct in code.
Optionally exercise write flows (m-dsr-create submit, m-pr-create submit, m-smp-assess, m-smp-decide, product edit price) end-to-end with TEST_ data — infrastructure and testIDs are all in place.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileMdApp.jsx is only ~180 lines and cleanly composed — good separation.
MobileMdViews.jsx is 547 lines — approaching split threshold; consider splitting into per-domain modules (Desk/Design/Sample/Products/Purchasing) for maintainability but not urgent.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all testIDs and screens render; one navigation path needs re-test)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is served from static bundle — after src edits run `bash /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh`. Preview URL: https://knhost-responsive.preview.emergentagent.com. MD login md@kainnusantara.id/demo12345 lands on data-testid=mobile-md-app at 390x844. Testable write flows require switching entity to ent_ksc via m-md-entity-ent_ksc (Semua mode blocks writes with 409). Notif sheet close testid should be added or the sheet needs a stable close button testid — Escape closing is not reliable across all overlay implementations.
